title: Rank-one ordinary scalar comparison
statement: For the chart data of [def-weil-pbc-finite-perfect-adic-scalar-realization] and the completed reduction of [lem-weil-pbc-completed-constant-sheaf-reduction], there is a family of isomorphisms between the ordinary source and target functors whose consecutive square commutes on the rank-one quotient module.

proof.text: Identify constant sections after the etale and pro-etale inverse-image maps and apply the completed finite-reduction comparison to the free rank-one quotient.
The quotient projection identity gives the consecutive square on the rank-one quotient module.

lean.statement:
theorem finitePerfectAdicOrdinaryScalar_components
    (X : Scheme.{t}) {A : Type t} [CommRing A] (d : AdicCoefficientDatum A)
    (V : X.Etale) (U : V.left.ProEt) (W : X.ProEt)
    (f : W ⟶ finitePerfectAdicChartObject V U) :
    ∃ e : ∀ n : ℕ, finitePerfectAdicOrdinaryScalarSource X d V U W f n ≅
        finitePerfectAdicOrdinaryScalarTarget X d W n,
      ∀ (n : ℕ),
        (e (n + 1)).hom.app
            ((ModuleCat.restrictScalars
              (Ideal.Quotient.factorPowSucc d.ideal (n + 1))).obj
              (ModuleCat.of (A ⧸ d.ideal ^ (n + 1))
                (A ⧸ d.ideal ^ (n + 1)))) ≫
          (finitePerfectAdicOrdinaryScalarTargetStep X d W n).hom.app
            (ModuleCat.of (A ⧸ d.ideal ^ (n + 1))
              (A ⧸ d.ideal ^ (n + 1))) =
        (finitePerfectAdicOrdinaryScalarSourceStep X d V U W f n).hom.app
            (ModuleCat.of (A ⧸ d.ideal ^ (n + 1))
              (A ⧸ d.ideal ^ (n + 1))) ≫
          (e n).hom.app
            (ModuleCat.of (A ⧸ d.ideal ^ (n + 1))
              (A ⧸ d.ideal ^ (n + 1)))
